messages:
emma: Quick heads-up — we're running a Maintainers Summit (virtual) the week of May 12. Goal: workshop maintainership practices, run short lightning talks, and surface plugin ideas. Call for workshop proposals open until Apr 30. Submit here: https://tiny.redwood/summit-cfp

saira: Love this. Can we include a beginner track for new maintainers? Many external contributors would benefit.

ken: We'll need session leads for topics: release automation, security reviews, and contributor onboarding. Happy to run release automation.

olivia: I'll run a short talk on triage dashboards and alerting for community repos.

dev-rel-bot: CFP form submitted by @olivia: https://forms.redwood/submit/573

emma: Awesome — adding @ken and @olivia to the organizer list. Agenda draft will be shared next week.

saira: Any thoughts on timezones? Weeklong format may be best; can record keynotes.

emma: Plan is spread across three afternoons in each major timezone (NA / EU / APAC) + recordings + office hours. We'll publish times after we collate proposals.

ops-bot: calendar event created: Maintainers Summit Week — organizers: emma, ken, olivia — https://calendar.redwood/evt/9987

ken: Can we offer small travel stipends for 2 invited external maintainers? Budget question for finance.

emma: Good point. I'll loop in finance. cc: @olivia please tag potential external maintainers you think we should invite.

olivia: Will do. Also propose a community mentorship roundtable — pair new maintainers with a mentor for 30 days.

emma: Love it. We're aiming for a lightweight, inclusive event. Please file workshop proposals and ping this thread for blockers. :party_parrot:
